topPRs.title: fix(specs/flashblocks): remove duplicate "state" in 5 RPC endpoint descriptions
topPRs.author: 0xAxiom
topPRs.body:
## What

`specs/protocol/flashblocks.md` contained `preconfirmation state state` in five parallel RPC endpoint descriptions. Each was a copy-paste dup-word from the same template sentence.

**Lines fixed:**

| Line | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| 919  | `preconfirmation state state to construct` | `preconfirmation state to construct` |
| 1150 | `preconfirmation state state to return the account balance` | `preconfirmation state to return the account balance` |
| 1174 | `preconfirmation state state to return the call result` | `preconfirmation state to return the call result` |
| 1226 | `contract bytecode from the preconfirmation state state.` | `contract bytecode from the preconfirmation state.` |
| 1273 | `preconfirmation state state. If the requested account` | `preconfirmation state. If the requested account` |

## Why

Prose fix only — no spec behaviour changed. Each occurrence is a simple duplicate word in a description of how JSON-RPC endpoints use the Flashblocks preconfirmation state.
